result:
I’d make it impossible for people to completely forget that other people are as real as they are.

Not constant empathy, and not universal agreement—those could become their own kind of tyranny. Just a stubborn awareness that behind every face is an entire world: memories, fears, private jokes, grief no one else can see.

So much harm begins when someone becomes an abstraction—an enemy, a statistic, a resource, a crowd. People could still disagree, compete, even hate. But the quiet act of erasing another person’s inner life would become much harder.

I wouldn’t make humans harmless. I’d make dehumanization difficult.
